_doc: Stamina rules every fighter shares (each fighter's own max, regen and guard drain stay in data/creatures/<id>.json). A dodge (dash) costs dodge_cost_share of the fighter's max stamina,, or its own share from dodge_cost_share_by_fighter (an id and a share, such as digby 0.4, for a cheaper dash). A blocked hit drains damage x guard.drain_per_damage x block_drain_mult[the move's type] stamina, and health chip as before (guard.reduction). A blocked hit pauses regen for block_regen_pause_seconds, restarted by every blocked hit. At 0 stamina (from a dodge or a blocked hit) the fighter is exhausted: it can't start a guard, a held guard drops and the hit that emptied it lands clean (no extra stun), and regen waits exhaust_delay_seconds (instead of the block pause, not on top of it).
